title: Stay on Camera
intro: A caller says your SIM was used in a crime. He wants you on a video call and tells you to tell no one.
This time you can talk back. Pick your replies and sniff each message as it arrives.
Every chat ends with your choice. Choose wisely.

notify.text: Your SIM is linked to a serious case

msg: Join the video call now and

replies.text: I will hang up and report this

msg: . You can clear your name only by

msg.text: Tell no one. If you do, it is a crime.

replies.text: That is not how cases work. I am telling my family and ending this.

msg.text: send your savings to our "safe account"

msg: so we can check them. They will be returned after.

replies.text: No. I am ending the call and calling the helpline.
I will go to the police station in person

num.label: An unknown number
num.lens: A stranger calling about a serious case.
num.why: Real cases do not begin with a surprise call.

crime.label: A crime story
crime.lens: Your SIM was supposedly used for illegal transfers.

arrest.label: "You may be arrested today"
arrest.lens: A threat of arrest by phone.
arrest.why: Arrests do not happen through a screen.

stay.label: "Stay on camera"
stay.why: Keeping you on camera is how victims are controlled.

proof.label: "We have proof"
proof.lens: They claim proof but show none.
proof.why: No proof is shown because there is none.

co.label: "Clear your name by cooperating"
co.lens: They make you feel guilty so you obey.

verify.label: "Send savings to a safe account"
verify.why: No honest officer asks you to move money.

rush.label: 20 minutes
rush.lens: A deadline to stop you thinking.

actions.label: Send the savings to the "safe account"
Tell my family and visit the police station in person
End the call and report it to your local fraud-reporting service

block_report.line: You ended the call and reported it. The number was traced and the account frozen.

verify.line: At the station they said: no case, no arrest, no officer by that name. Case cracked.

go_ahead.line: The savings moved to a stranger. The "officer" and the account disappeared.

what_if.go_ahead: Telling one family member would have broken the spell. The secrecy was the trap.
what_if.verify: Going in person was safe. Reporting the call as well helps trace the number.

golden_rule: No one can arrest you through a screen, and no one honest says "tell no one". End the call and tell someone you trust.

quick_check.q: A caller says your SIM was used for a crime, keeps you on camera and tells you not to tell anyone. What is the best move?

options.text: End the call, tell someone you trust and to your local fraud-reporting service

quick_check.explain: The secrecy is the clue. A trusted person ends the spell.

hints.nudge: Why would a real officer ask you to keep it secret?

rows.k: Asked you to tell no one
Criminals pose as police and keep victims on video calls

rows.v: The fraud-reporting service in your country
